turns.question: What was our revenue in the third quarter of fiscal 2026?
turns.answer: Revenue (EUR) for fiscal Q3 of fiscal 2026 (2026-08-01 to 2026-10-31) was EUR 19,793.59, though the sales data is only loaded up to 2026-10-03, so October is largely missing. Late: sales.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
